projects.title: PicFive
projects.description: A social web-based game designed and created at Uoft Hacks IV. Given five generated categories, players must take a photo that falls into as many of the groups as possible. They are then given a score based on how well the photo fits all five categories. PicFive was built using a primarily JavaScript stack of Node.js, Express, Handlebars, and JQuery. Additionally, scores were stored in a MongoDB database for a leaderboard display. The app uses Clarifai's image recognition technology to tag and score the image.
